Behind the visuals

Hands-on from first frame to final edit.

I’m Vijay, a developing visual creative based in Hyderabad. I joined EVOL Jewels in November 2025 as an intern in Audio & Visuals. My first six months went into learning production workflows, lighting and brand visual language; since then I’ve taken on more hands-on production and post-production work.

My work includes mobile BTS and event videos, jewellery e-commerce photography support, photo and video editing, product and model retouching, graphic posters and AI-assisted visual concepts.

PhotographyVideographyVideo editingLighting assistanceRetouchingGraphic designAI visuals

Tools: Photoshop, Lightroom, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude, Google Flow. Currently learning Adobe Premiere Pro.
